content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Chicago

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific education and hours-of-experience thresholds for the PMP credential. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can walk you through your background to confirm you meet the baseline requirements.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. You'll attend interactive sessions on your schedule, covering the PMBOK Guide framework, risk management, stakeholder communication, and exam strategy. All training is conducted online, allowing you to learn from Chicago while maintaining your work commitments.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of your education and project experience. Pay the associated PMI exam fee at that time. PMI will review and approve your application before you're authorized to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—including practice exams, strategy sessions, and Q&A support—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's approved testing partner. The exam is computer-based and available at test centers throughout Chicago and online.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you'll enter a 3-year renewal cycle. Maintain your credential by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or professional activities. Renew your certification and fees before expiration to keep your PMP active and recognized by employers across your local job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
